name: @redsocs/spam-warden
description: Lightweight client-side JavaScript library for real-time spam detection. Trained on Thai spam data using Bernoulli Naive Bayes.

scripts.test: node -e "const sw = require('./dist/spamwarden.min.js'); const r1 = sw.spamcheck('สมัครสมาชิกวันนี้ รับโบนัส ฝากเงิน'); const r2 = sw.spamcheck('Hello world'); if (!r1.isSpam) { console.error('FAIL: spam not detected'); process.exit(1); } if (r2.isSpam) { console.error('FAIL: safe detected as spam'); process.exit(1); } console.log('PASS');"

author: RedSocs
